versions.changelog: Reduced allowed-tools to minimal set (AskUserQuestion only). Removed unnecessary filesystem tools (Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob) that were flagged by security scan.
Consolidated duplicate reference sections into single References & Sources section.
Restructured forensic detection sections with cleaner formatting. Better organized flag conditions, human markers, and fix actions.
Added 2025-2026 forensic detection metrics (perplexity, burstiness), Unicode artifact scanning, expanded AI vocabulary lists, detection benchmarks, and quick-fix humanization checklist.
Remove AI writing patterns. Based on Wikipedia's Signs of AI Writing guide.
